phenotype_specificity.statement: Only the two table entries (arthritis, dermatitis) are given; no information on exclusion of other causes. The cited source's title, as listed in the reference list, describes the disease as familial Blau syndrome without uveitis.

quotes.quote: SA. Familial Blau syndrome without uveitis caused by a novel mutation in the nucleotide-binding oligomerization domain-containing protein 2 gene with good response to infliximab.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Missense (predicted p.His576Arg on NP_001357395.1). This paper gives no protein change for this entry and no mechanism statement specific to it.

authors_classification.statement: This paper gives no classification for this variant. The title of the cited source (reference 40), as listed in the reference list, calls it a novel mutation causing familial Blau syndrome.

SA. Familial Blau syndrome without uveitis caused by a novel mutation in the nucleotide-binding oligomerization domain-containing protein 2 gene with good response to infliximab.

concerns: Review-table only: the variant appears in one row of a literature-review table (Table 3) with no case description; the primary report (Toral-López et al., Pediatr Dermatol 2018;35:180-3) is not among the batch papers, so sex, zygosity, family members and any segregation or functional data are unavailable here.

Numbering and placement: the table gives only 'c.1808A>G', with no transcript and no protein change. The batch placed it as NM_001370466.1:c.1727A>G (p.(His576Arg)), which assumes the older NM_022162 numbering (81 nt higher than MANE; by codon arithmetic c.1808 is the second base of codon 603 on that transcript). This assumption cannot be checked from this paper; the panel should confirm against the primary report before relying on the placement.
Possible inconsistency: the table counts 1 patient, while the cited source's title describes 'Familial Blau syndrome'; relatives may carry the same variant and be reported in the primary paper.

The Table 3 header in the converted text is garbled ('Table 3. Clinical Cuesta et al. 25 | features of 3 | patients receiving ...'); the row-to-reference assignment for row 24 is clean, but the table was read from a converted PDF.
notes_for_panel: Weakest of these four: a single review-table row (arthritis, dermatitis, c.1808A>G) citing Toral-López et al. 2018. Nothing person-level beyond the table; the placement on MANE (c.1727A>G, His576Arg) rests on an assumed legacy transcript. The primary report would be needed for any evidence.
